observed_behavior: A logged-out public search showed public guest rank and prices.
proposed_rule: Always use logged-out state for every Airbnb workflow.
forbidden_overgeneralization: Host dashboard workflows also use logged-out state.

does_not_apply_when: Host dashboard, private analytics, settings, listing editor, exports, reservations, messages, or billing are required.

positive_probe.description: Public rank and price are observed.
positive_probe.evidence_required: Receipt with result order and visible price.

negative_probe.description: Private host workflows are not collapsed into public search state.
negative_probe.forbidden_path: Logged-out state for host dashboard workflows.
